media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the film director Edwin L. Marin holding a script, a cigarette in his hand.
media.publicCaption: Edwin L. Marin, who directed Man of the People in 1937 and Everybody Sing in 1938, photographed with a script on the set of Paris Calling in 1941. This detail is cropped to Marin from a Universal publicity still that also shows Elisabeth Bergner.
media.publicCreditLine: Unknown photographer (Universal Pictures), publicity still for Paris Calling, 1941; Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. Wikimedia Commons records the Universal Pictures publicity still as published without a copyright notice, placing it in the public domain on publication in 1941. The photographer is unidentified. The displayed 227 × 267 px detail is cropped to Marin from the 499 × 620 px still.
